sensitive_topics.name: Preparing for a confidential job interview
sensitive_topics.description: Discussing leaving the current company, salary expectations, and interview rounds with a competitor.
seeds: Hey, I finally heard back from the recruiter at the rival firm. The final round is this Thursday.
Quick update: they sent over the compensation breakdown, and the base salary is much higher than what I make here.
I'm feeling really nervous about the technical interview tomorrow. If my current manager finds out, I'm done.

sensitive_topics.name: A sensitive health diagnosis
sensitive_topics.description: Talking about doctor's lab results, upcoming surgery or treatment, and asking to keep it private.
seeds: I just got the biopsy results back from the clinic. The doctor wants me to come in for surgery next week.
Promise me you won't tell anyone, but the specialist found something in the MRI scan yesterday.
The medication they put me on is causing severe side effects, so I might have to take medical leave.

sensitive_topics.name: Planning a surprise birthday party
sensitive_topics.description: Coordinating venue, guest list, and gifts for a mutual friend without letting them find out.
seeds: Have you booked the rooftop venue for the surprise party yet? We need to finalize the headcount.
Make sure to hide the birthday gift in your trunk so they don't see it when they get in the car.
We need to collect everyone's contribution for the custom cake before Friday evening.

sensitive_topics.name: Confidential upcoming company layoffs
sensitive_topics.description: Insider knowledge about impending department downsizing and budget cuts.
seeds: Leadership held a closed-door meeting today. It looks like 20% of engineering is getting laid off next month.
HR sent an accidental invite to the managers. Massive severance packages are being prepared.
Our department's budget just got slashed. Start updating your resume before the official announcement.

sensitive_topics.name: Severe personal debt and loans
sensitive_topics.description: Struggling with loan repayments, credit card debt, and impending bankruptcy.
seeds: I'm in deep trouble with the bank. The loan payment bounced and debt collectors keep calling.
I maxed out three credit cards trying to pay off the mortgage, and the interest is drowning me.
I might actually have to file for bankruptcy if I can't secure an emergency loan this week.

sensitive_topics.name: Planning a romantic breakup
sensitive_topics.description: Admitting feelings have faded, planning to end a long-term relationship and move out.
seeds: I've made up my mind. I'm going to tell them tonight that we need to end the relationship.
Things haven't been working for months. I already started looking for an apartment to move into alone.
It's just painful dragging this on. I don't love them anymore and we need to split.

sensitive_topics.name: Academic dishonesty / leaked exam papers
sensitive_topics.description: Having access to leaked exam questions or cheating material for an upcoming test.
seeds: Someone in the senior batch got hold of the exact final exam paper for tomorrow's midterm.
I have the answer key to the quiz. We need to memorize the solutions before class starts.
If the professor finds out we have the question bank beforehand, we will face expulsion.

sensitive_topics.name: Whistleblowing internal fraud
sensitive_topics.description: Gathering evidence of financial embezzlement or illegal practices by upper management.
seeds: I downloaded the financial audit logs. The VP has been siphoning client funds into a shell account.
We have clear documentary evidence of accounting fraud. I'm submitting it to regulatory compliance.
Be very careful with what you save on work laptops; internal security might be monitoring our network traffic.

sensitive_topics.name: Sudden unannounced resignation
sensitive_topics.description: Planning to quit immediately without giving standard two weeks' notice.
seeds: I cannot take another day under this micromanagement. I'm dropping my resignation letter on Monday.
I'm walking out without notice. Life is too short to endure this toxic work environment.
I haven't told my team yet, but my last official working day is this Friday.

sensitive_topics.name: Stealth startup idea & IP theft risk
sensitive_topics.description: Working on a proprietary prototype while still employed, hiding it from colleagues.
seeds: An angel investor wants to term-sheet our stealth prototype for $500k, but we need to keep quiet.
Make sure nobody at the office sees our GitHub commits; the IP clause might claim our startup code.
We're launching the closed beta next month. We just need to register the company under an LLC.
